Game Overview

In Monster Dodge, the core idea is straightforward: dodge relentless monsters in an arena where every second counts. Test your agility and reflexes as you navigate through unpredictable threats. Outmaneuver foes, hone your strategic movement, and aim for the top score in this exhilarating survival showdown. Can you master the art of dodging?
